related.title: 塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「318 廠區全黑事件的時序」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Sequence of the 18 March station blackout" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣唯一的壓水式核電廠：318 全黑事件、鹽霧害與溫排水；塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠則以英國唯一的壓水式機組：雙汽輪發電機、強化的安全串列與延役評估為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's only PWR plant: the March 2001 station blackout, salt contamination and thermal discharge; Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station centres on britain's only PWR: twin turbine generators, reinforced safety trains and life extension, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的模型移到塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「多重且多樣的安全串列」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Steam flow and turbine size" to Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Redundant and diverse safety trains", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「318 廠區全黑事件的時序」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；塞斯韋爾 B 壓水式核電廠的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Sequence of the 18 March station blackout" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Sizewell B Pressurized-Water Station must be respecified.

related.title: 國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「318 廠區全黑事件的時序」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Sequence of the 18 March station blackout" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦臺灣唯一的壓水式核電廠：318 全黑事件、鹽霧害與溫排水；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程則以BWR-6 與馬克三型圍阻體：抑壓池、用過燃料池容量、乾式貯存與二十五年除役為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on taiwan's only PWR plant: the March 2001 station blackout, salt contamination and thermal discharge; Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning centres on BWR-6 with Mark III containment: suppression pool, spent-fuel pool capacity, dry storage and a twenty-five-year decommissioning, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「蒸汽流量與汽輪機規模」的模型移到國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「乾式貯存護箱的數量」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Steam flow and turbine size" to Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The number of dry-storage casks", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「318 廠區全黑事件的時序」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；國聖核能二廠 BWR-6 與除役工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Sequence of the 18 March station blackout" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Kuosheng BWR-6 Plant and Decommissioning must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 馬鞍山核能三廠壓水式機組
history.titleEn: Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant PWR Units
history.text: 1978 年工程開工；1984 年1 號機商轉；2001 年1 號機發生 318 廠區全黑事件；2025 年2 號機執照屆期停機，臺灣暫無核能發電。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1978: Construction began. 1984: Unit 1 entered commercial operation. 2001: The 18 March station blackout occurred at unit 1. 2025: Unit 2 stopped at licence expiry, leaving Taiwan without nuclear generation for the time being. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
